device.description: 12-bit 3.3 kSPS 4-channel delta-sigma ADC with PGA, temperature sensor and SPI interface
device.note: ads1018.pdf (SBAS526D) p.4 pin functions, p.5 recommended operating conditions, p.8 serial timing and switching characteristics, p.14 temperature sensor, p.15 modes, p.16 serial interface and DOUT/DRDY, p.17 data format, p.17-18 data retrieval (Figures 13-15), p.19-20 register map

registers.name: CONVERSION
registers.note: Figure 16: D11-D0 in bits 15:4, bits 3:0 read 0

registers.name: CONFIG
registers.note: Figure 17: reset 058Bh; SS write 1 starts a single conversion and always reads 0; bit 0 always reads 1

commands.name: Config write
commands.note: first 16 DIN bits; written only when NOP[1:0] = 01b (other values: no write). Bits after the 16th are ignored

pages: p.4 (pins: SCLK1 CS2 GND3 AIN0-3 4-7 VDD8 DOUT/DRDY9 DIN10, RUG/DGS same numbering), p.5 (ROC: VDD 2-5.5 V, digital inputs GND-VDD), p.8 (tCSDOD 100 ns, tDOPD 50 ns, tCSDOZ 100 ns; DIN latched on SCLK falling, DOUT shifted on SCLK rising), p.15 (power-up in power-down/single-shot; SS starts one conversion), p.16 (DOUT/DRDY low = new data, high 8 us before the next data in continuous mode if unread), p.17 (two's complement, left-justified), p.17-18 (32-bit cycle: data then config read-back; 16-bit cycle), p.19-20 (registers)
notModeled: analog inputs, PGA and temperature sensor (TS_MODE is stored only; a temperature conversion returns the 0 V code, 0 C)
DOUT/DRDY in continuous mode goes high 8 us before the next data-ready if the data were not read: the model keeps it low until read
the config read-back in bits 17-32 shows the Config just written in bits 1-16 (Figure 13); the model's out pattern may show the value at CS fall
the data word is locked at the start of a transmission (no corruption): not modeled beyond the fixed frame
CS tied low (3-wire use): frames are delimited only by CS in the model
SPI timeout (SCLK low 28 ms resets the interface); SCLK period limits
weak internal pullup on DOUT/DRDY while CS is high (PULL_UP_EN stored only; the pin is Z)
DR = 111b is 'not used' (the model uses the slowest time)
writes of SS = 1 during a conversion or in continuous mode: no effect per the datasheet
